name: Flowers Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Plant.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the wooden fist power of the Plant domain.

Pollen Cloud (Sp)

As a standard action, you can blow a cloud of scented pollen at a creature within 30 ft. The target must make a Will save (DC = 10 + ½ your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier); if it fails, it is fascinated for 1d4 rounds.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. This is a mind-affecting effect.

Replacement Domain Spells: 3rd-ward of the season (spring), 4th-flowers hurricane.
